example.en: She applied for a job in the new mall.
example.zh: 她應徵了新商場的一份工作。

example.en: I must submit a sales report today.
example.zh: 我今天必須要提交一份銷售報告。

example.en: We are discussing the budget cuts with the director.
example.zh: 我們正在和主管討論削減預算。

example.en: The order was shipped last week, but we still haven't received it.
example.zh: 訂單上週就出貨了，但是我們到現在都還沒收到。

example.en: The company will release a new smartphone next month.
example.zh: 那間公司下個月將會推出一款新型智慧型手機。

phrases.meaning_zh: 讓 A 升遷至經理一職

example.en: It's always beneficial to promote your company over the Internet.
example.zh: 在網路上宣傳自家公司總是有益處。

phrases.phrase: provide A with B = provide B for A

example.en: Bob provided continuous updates on his work progress.
example.zh: 鮑伯不斷更新自己的工作進度。

phrases.meaning_zh: 依照 C 的價格向 A 收取 B
控告 A 犯下 B 罪名

example.en: The catering company charged us $1,600 for the party.
example.zh: 這間餐飲公司向我們收取 1600 美元的派對費用。

example.en: Veronica appreciated the help from her colleagues on the database upgrade.
example.zh: 維洛妮卡很感謝她的同事幫忙升級資料庫。

example.en: The board of directors accepted the committee's report.
example.zh: 董事會接受了委員會的報告。

example.en: She didn't approve of the CEO's decision to relocate abroad.
example.zh: 她不贊成執行長將公司遷至國外的決定。

example.en: We need to adopt a new approach to increase sales.
example.zh: 我們需要採取新方法來提升銷售額。

headword.meaning_zh: 動 增加；增強 / 名 增加

example.en: It's Mary's job to come up with ways to increase business.
example.zh: 瑪莉的工作就是想出拓展生意的方法。

example.en: The shop owner expanded her store by adding another room.
example.zh: 店主新增了一個房間來擴大店面。

example.en: All employees are required to attend the morning meetings.
example.zh: 全體員工都必須參加早上的會議。

example.en: The customers entered the shop and inquired about prices.
example.zh: 顧客進到店裡詢問價格。

example.en: The manager assigned us the new project and asked us to finish it by the weekend.
example.zh: 經理指派新企劃給我們，並要求我們在週末以前完成。

example.en: It is your duty to designate a new leader of the team.
example.zh: 為團隊指派新領導者是你的職責。

example.en: Mr. Lee indicated his wishes for new contract terms in a letter.
example.zh: 李先生在信中表明希望能更新合約條款。

example.en: Elise implied she might transfer to Shanghai if she were promoted.
example.zh: 愛麗絲暗示她如果升遷的話，有可能會調去上海。

example.en: Poor sales caused the company to file for bankruptcy.
example.zh: 銷售不佳導致這間公司申請破產。

example.en: As this is a legal matter, you will have to consult with an attorney.
example.zh: 由於這是法律問題，你得諮詢律師才行。

example.en: Leslie recommended her friend for the open position at her company.
example.zh: 萊絲莉推薦朋友去應徵她公司的職缺。

example.en: All employees are encouraged to have a yearly medical checkup.
example.zh: 鼓勵全體員工每年做一次體檢。

example.en: Visitors to the website must register and become members in order to access information.
example.zh: 網站訪客必須註冊成為會員才能獲取資訊。

phrases.meaning_zh: 註冊修讀／報名參加一堂課程

example.en: Enroll today in our special course on starting a business.
example.zh: 今天就來報名參加我們的創業特別課程吧！

phrases.meaning_zh: 搜索 A 來尋找 B

example.en: Mel has been searching for the missing file for days.
example.zh: 梅爾尋找不見的檔案已經好幾天了。

example.en: The accountant subscribes to the daily financial paper.
example.zh: 那名會計師訂閱財經日報。

example.en: After Mr. Robinson's contract expired, he looked for a new job.
example.zh: 羅賓森先生在合約到期之後尋找新工作。

phrases.meaning_zh: 通知 A 關於 B 的事

example.en: The personnel department notified the staff about the change in working hours.
example.zh: 人事部門通知員工，工時變動一事。

example.en: Let us calculate the value of your house and land.
example.zh: 我們來算算你的房子跟土地值多少錢。

headword.meaning_zh: 動 估計；估價 / 名 估計；估價

example.en: It's difficult to estimate the results of the marketing survey in advance.
example.zh: 很難事先估算出市場調查的結果。

example.en: This savings account earns over 3 percent interest on deposited funds.
example.zh: 這個儲蓄帳戶的存款利率超過 3%。

example.en: We can't afford to buy a house now.
example.zh: 我們現在買不起一間房子。

example.en: The firm donated proceeds from the event to a children's charity.
example.zh: 公司把這場活動的收入捐給一間兒童慈善機構。

headword.meaning_zh: 動 雇用；租用 / 名 新進員工

example.en: The PR department hired a new clerk to do administrative duties.
example.zh: 公關部門雇用了一名新職員處理行政業務。

headword.meaning_zh: 動 推出；發起 / 名 推出；發行

example.en: The corporation launched its new product with commercials on the major networks.
example.zh: 這家公司推出了新產品，並在主流電視台打廣告。

example.en: The annual report proved to be false.
example.zh: 結果證實這份年度報告是假的。

example.en: This year's models are displayed in the window.
example.zh: 今年的模型在櫥窗中展示。

example.en: The candidate celebrated with his supporters after the victory.
example.zh: 那位候選人勝選之後和他的支持者一起慶祝。

example.en: I was asked to replace Ms. Moss as host of the annual event.
example.zh: 我受託代替摩絲小姐擔任年度活動的主持人。

phrases.meaning_zh: 將 A 調整成 B

example.en: The employees were unable to adjust to the strict working conditions.
example.zh: 這批員工沒辦法適應嚴苛的工作環境。

example.en: We must fix the projector before the presentation.
example.zh: 我們必須在簡報開始前修理好投影機。

headword.meaning_zh: 動 造成；導致 / 名 原因；理由

example.en: We apologize for the inconvenience caused by this delay.
example.zh: 對於此次延誤造成的不便，我們深感抱歉。

headword.meaning_zh: 動 保證，擔保 / 名 保證；抵押品

example.en: The president guaranteed wage increases in his video message.
example.zh: 董事長在影片中保證會調漲薪資。

headword.meaning_zh: 動 更新，升級 / 名 最新消息

example.en: It's a good idea to frequently update your computer system to avoid viruses.
example.zh: 時常更新電腦系統來防範病毒是個好主意。

example.en: Sara described the product in detail to the client.
example.zh: 莎拉向客戶鉅細靡遺地介紹產品。

example.en: The boss instructed me to bring the client to a nearby cafe.
example.zh: 老闆吩咐我帶客戶去附近的一間咖啡廳。

example.en: Her team laid out a plan to address falling sales at the firm.
example.zh: 她的團隊展開一項計畫來處理公司業績下滑的問題。

example.en: Here are some tips to resolve conflicts at work.
example.zh: 這裡有幾個解決職場衝突的小秘訣。

example.en: The company concluded it would cut labor costs by 20%.
example.zh: 公司最終決定削減 20% 的人力成本。

phrases.meaning_zh: 說服 A 相信 B

example.en: We'll need time to convince the boss of our new plan.
example.zh: 我們需要花時間說服老闆採納我們的新計畫。

adjective.meaning_zh: 有說服力的，讓人信服的

example.en: The management committee determines departmental policy.
example.zh: 管理階層決定各部門政策。

example.en: The manager insisted that the client accept the gift.
example.zh: 經理堅持要客戶收下禮物。

example.en: The company's careful preparations ensured its success.
example.zh: 公司小心翼翼的準備工作確保了其成功。

headword.meaning_zh: 動 引用；報價 / 名 引文；報價

example.en: The author began his speech by quoting a famous historian.
example.zh: 作者引用一位有名的歷史學家的話做為演講的開場白。

example.en: Dave finally realized his lifelong ambition to become a lawyer.
example.zh: 戴夫終於實現當律師的人生志業。

example.en: Our company achieved a record amount of sales last quarter.
example.zh: 我們公司上一季的銷售額創歷史新高。

example.en: The CEO fulfilled his promise to cut operating costs by 15%.
example.zh: 執行長履行諾言，削減了 15% 的營運成本。

example.en: It was decided that our team would conduct the series of surveys.
example.zh: 後來決定由我們團隊進行一系列的調查。

example.en: Tim got a promotion because his hard work was recognized.
example.zh: 提姆能升遷是因為他認真工作的態度得到了認同。

example.en: Mr. Warner admires those who work hard to make a living.
example.zh: 華納先生很欣賞認真工作謀生的人。

example.en: The private life of the famous CEO fascinates the public.
example.zh: 那位名執行長的私生活為大眾津津樂道。

example.en: Our company boasts a wide range of products and services.
example.zh: 我們公司以擁有多種產品和服務為傲。

example.en: The annual budget meeting has been postponed until next week.
example.zh: 年度預算會議被延到下週舉行。

example.en: Many employees participated in Dr. Ayala's lecture on the latest design trends.
example.zh: 很多員工參加了阿亞拉博士探討最新設計趨勢的講座。

example.en: After the database crashed, the systems engineer located the source of the error.
example.zh: 資料庫當機之後，系統工程師找到了出錯的源頭。

example.en: Please enclose your résumé with the application and send it to our office.
example.zh: 請在求職信中附上您的履歷寄到本辦公室。

example.en: The budget includes financing for our planned expansion into India.
example.zh: 這筆預算包含我們計劃拓展印度市場的資金。

headword.meaning_zh: 動 同意；許可 / 名 同意；承諾

example.en: She has consented to the terms of the contract.
example.zh: 她已同意合約條款。

headword.meaning_zh: 動 允許，准許 / 名 許可證

example.en: The new agreement permits both parties to sell each other's goods.
example.zh: 新協議准許雙方販售彼此的商品。

phrases.phrase: I was wondering if you could...

example.en: I wondered how long it would take for us to reach an agreement.
example.zh: 我很納悶要多久才能取得共識。

example.en: Frieda quit her job as a receptionist to attend business school full-time.
example.zh: 芙蕾達辭掉櫃台接待人員的工作，去商學院讀書了。

example.en: You can avoid eye strain and stress by taking a break every hour.
example.zh: 每小時休息一次即可避免眼睛疲勞與壓力。

example.en: Jason almost missed the project deadline, since he fell behind.
example.zh: 因為進度落後的緣故，傑森差點趕不上企劃案截止日期。

example.en: Inflation affects the buying power of the dollar.
example.zh: 通貨膨脹會影響美元的購買力。

example.en: Bad weather prevented us from going on the company picnic.
example.zh: 由於天候不佳，公司的野餐活動無法舉辦。

example.en: Visitors are prohibited from using flash photography inside the cathedral.
example.zh: 遊客禁止在大教堂內使用閃光燈拍照。

example.en: Question and answer sessions are restricted to 20 minutes.
example.zh: 問答時間限制為 20 分鐘。

example.en: The boss didn't hesitate to give his approval of the new plan.
example.zh: 老闆毫不猶豫地准許了新計畫。

example.en: The secretary's work was disturbed by constant phone calls.
example.zh: 秘書的工作被響不停的電話頻頻打斷。

verb.meaning_zh: 打斷他人說話；暫時停止

example.en: The secretary neglected to return the client's call.
example.zh: 秘書忘記回電給客戶。

example.en: Janet politely declined my offer to help her move.
example.zh: 珍妮特婉拒了我幫她搬家的提議。

example.en: Chloe withdrew her application for employment with the trading company.
example.zh: 克蘿伊撤回了進入那間貿易公司工作的申請書。

example.en: Roy has completely recovered from the injuries he received in the accident.
example.zh: 羅伊在車禍中受的傷已經完全復原了。

example.en: The health department inspected our restaurant kitchen without prior notice.
example.zh: 衛生部門未提前告知便前來視察我們餐廳的廚房。

example.en: We need to come up with measures to protect our intellectual property.
example.zh: 我們需要想出措施來保護我們的智慧財產權。

example.en: It's impossible to obey unrealistic demands of the company president.
example.zh: 要遵從公司董事長不切實際的要求簡直不可能。

example.en: The president did not mention his retirement plans during his speech.
example.zh: 主席未在演講中提到他的退休規劃。

example.en: The manager predicted the marketing campaign would positively impact sales.
example.zh: 經理預測這場行銷活動將為營業額帶來正面的影響。

example.en: The CEO emphasized the positive aspects of the merger.
example.zh: 執行長再三強調企業合併的好處。

phrases.meaning_zh: 以 B 為理由譴責 A

example.en: The mayor was accused of delaying the decision on the construction.
example.zh: 市長遭人譴責拖延建設決策。

example.en: It took me a while to comprehend what the boss meant.
example.zh: 我花了一段時間才明白老闆的意思。

example.en: The patent dispute between the two companies was settled out of court.
example.zh: 兩個公司之間的專利紛爭在庭外取得和解。

example.en: The profits from the sale exceeded our expectations.
example.zh: 銷售利潤超出我們的預期。

example.en: I'd like to extend my stay until 6 P.M. as I have an evening flight.
example.zh: 由於我的班機在傍晚，所以我想延長住宿時間到晚上 6 點。

example.en: The news about the CEO's departure quickly spread throughout the nation.
example.zh: 執行長辭職的消息很快就傳遍了整個國家。

example.en: Big business must also do its part to preserve natural resources.
example.zh: 大企業也必須盡責維護自然資源。

example.en: Workers must observe safety guidelines in the factory.
example.zh: 工人必須遵守工廠的安全準則。

example.en: George has been working hard for years, so he deserves a raise.
example.zh: 喬治認真工作了好幾年，加薪是他應得的。
